paragraphs.text: Gornog , also known as the Red Reaper , is a minotaur warrior from an unknown plane.

Gornog is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Red Warriors deck . He is a minotaur warrior who causes creatures to become Cowards and prevents any Cowards from blocking Warriors. He is a muscular minotaur who has a small amount of metal armor on his waist, thighs, and shoulders. Otherwise, he only wears a red loincloth and cape while wielding an axe.
